prose: Bloomberg’s report indexed by Techmeme says Alibaba claims Qwen4-Max outperforms named competitors on coding benchmarks and plans open weights for smaller Qwen4 models, while the flagship is not open weight. The article was inaccessible. Benchmark conditions, release timing and licenses for future models cannot be inferred from the excerpt.
highlights: Flagship and smaller models have different reported release plans
Future open weights are a plan
